svg.text: CSEEE-21 / SEN0161 conditioner / two 6 V dosing pumps / Nano ESP32 / illustrative, untested
1 CONDITION AND SCALE THE SENSOR SIGNAL
Use the supplied conditioner; do not connect
the raw glass electrode directly to an ADC.
C2/C3 next to U2; keep pump noise out of its supply.
Supply decoupling: these are electrical connections
U3: C4 100 nF + C5 1 uF across +6 V and GND at the IC.
U4: C6 100 nF + C7 1 uF across +6 V and GND at the IC.
Pump rail: C8 470 uF / 16 V + C9 100 nF to GND.
Shown explicitly on sheet 2 of the pH PDF.
Example dosing logic: firmware interlock required
Target pH 5.0: below 4.9 -> ALKALI; above 5.1 -> ACID.
Inside band: both OFF. Both OFF while mixing / settling.
Ramp starts; calibrate dose volume and wait before re-dosing.
This hardware does not independently block both pumps ON.
Pump supply: regulated 6 V, >=3 A example; actual start/stall currents must be checked. Pump current must not flow through the Nano.
D1/D2 band (K) to +6 V. All GND symbols common. Keep pump returns separate from the pH analog return.
Drivers are added example parts, not confirmed kit contents. TC4420 pin 3 NC. A1 / D6 / D9 are board labels, not raw GPIO numbers.
For normal operation only one pump may run. Invalid pH, loss of stirring or dose/time limits -> stop both pumps.
